graph.name: Item-Based Recommender System for Onaz
graph.notes: Architecture for Onaz's item-based recommender system, using clickstream data for personalization. The workflow involves periodic model training and deployment via SageMaker, with real-time inference served through API Gateway and Lambda. The diagram visually depicts recommendations directly from S3 to the user's browser, representing the served recommendations.

nodes.name: Event Bridge
nodes.notes: Periodically triggers the state machine workflow to refresh the ML model.

nodes.name: State Machine
nodes.notes: Manages the entire workflow for data pulling, training, and serving the machine learning model.

nodes.name: Preprocessing Lambda
nodes.notes: Invoked by the State Machine, queries Athena to pull and process customer browsing data, then pushes results to S3.

nodes.name: Athena
nodes.notes: Queries customer browsing data from the data lake for preprocessing.

nodes.name: Processed Data S3
nodes.notes: Stores pre-processed browsing data used for model training and visually depicted as the source for served recommendations.

nodes.name: SageMaker Training
nodes.notes: Reads browsing data from S3 to train a Word2Vec algorithm using the Blazing Text container.

nodes.name: SageMaker Deployment
nodes.notes: Deploys the trained model as an endpoint, handling configuration and deployment into production.

nodes.name: Recommendation Lambda
nodes.notes: Invoked by API Gateway, requests recommendations from the SageMaker endpoint and processes them.

nodes.name: API Gateway
nodes.notes: Streamlines authentication and routing of user requests to various SageMaker endpoints, managing APIs and security.

nodes.name: User Browser
nodes.notes: Represents the end-user interacting with the Onaz platform, browsing products, and receiving personalized recommendations.

edges.notes: EventBridge periodically triggers the machine learning workflow managed by the State Machine.
The State Machine invokes the Preprocessing Lambda as the first step of the workflow.
The Preprocessing Lambda queries Athena to retrieve browsing data.
Data sourced by Athena (and processed by Lambda) is stored in the S3 bucket.
The Preprocessing Lambda triggers the SageMaker training job after data preparation.
SageMaker Training reads the pre-processed browsing data from S3.
After training, SageMaker triggers the model deployment process.
User's browser sends a request to the API Gateway when browsing product pages.
API Gateway invokes the Recommendation Lambda to handle the request.
The Recommendation Lambda requests personalized recommendations from the SageMaker deployed endpoint.
The SageMaker endpoint returns recommended items to the Recommendation Lambda.
Visually, recommendations are depicted as being served from S3 directly to the user's frontend.
